stages.name: calls

      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: parameters
stages.query: SELECT p.* FROM a p JOIN a arguments ON arguments.__path=p.__path AND arguments.id=p.parent AND arguments.kind='arguments' JOIN functions f ON f.__path=arguments.__path AND f.id=arguments.parent WHERE p.kind='arg'

stages.name: qualified
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE q(__path,id,name) AS (
      SELECT __path,id,name FROM a WHERE kind='Name'
      UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.id,CASE WHEN p.kind='Attribute' THEN q.name||'.'||p.name ELSE q.name END
      FROM q JOIN a child ON child.__path=q.__path AND child.id=q.id
      JOIN a p ON p.__path=child.__path AND p.id=child.parent
      WHERE p.kind='Attribute' AND child.field='value' OR p.kind='Call' AND child.field='func') SELECT * FROM q

stages.name: single_decorators

stages.name: static_parts
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE parts(__path,root,id,kind,value,value_kind,op) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,kind,value,value_kind,op FROM a WHERE kind IN ('Constant','BinOp','JoinedStr') UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.root,n.id,n.kind,n.value,n.value_kind,n.op FROM parts p JOIN a parent ON parent.__path=p.__path AND parent.id=p.id JOIN a n ON n.__path=parent.__path AND n.parent=parent.id WHERE parent.kind='BinOp' AND parent.op='Add' AND n.field IN ('left','right') OR parent.kind='JoinedStr' AND n.field='values') SELECT * FROM parts

stages.name: static_strings

stages.name: type_parts
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE parts(__path,root,id) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM a WHERE field IN ('annotation','bases','type') UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.root,n.id FROM parts p JOIN a parent ON parent.__path=p.__path AND parent.id=p.id JOIN a n ON n.__path=parent.__path AND n.parent=parent.id WHERE parent.kind='Subscript' AND n.field='value' OR parent.kind='BinOp' AND parent.op='BitOr' AND n.field IN ('left','right')) SELECT p.__path,p.root,p.id,coalesce(q.name,'') label FROM parts p JOIN a n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.id LEFT JOIN qualified q ON q.__path=n.__path AND q.id=n.id AND n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') WHERE n.kind!='Subscript' AND NOT (n.kind='BinOp' AND n.op='BitOr')

stages.name: type_labels
stages.query: SELECT __path,root,group_concat(label,'|') label FROM (SELECT * FROM type_parts ORDER BY __path,root,id) GROUP BY __path,root

stages.name: matching_fields
stages.query: SELECT n.*,t.name field_name,v.id annotation_id,v.kind annotation_kind,v.name annotation_name,labels.label annotation_text,cls.name class_name FROM a n JOIN a t ON t.__path=n.__path AND t.parent=n.id AND t.field='target' AND t.kind='Name' JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='annotation' LEFT JOIN type_labels labels ON labels.__path=v.__path AND labels.root=v.id JOIN classes cls ON cls.__path=n.__path AND cls.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='AnnAssign' AND n.field='body'
